name: Kasuga Asagao
source:
“The Timid Yet Big-Breasted Older Sister”

She has a quiet and shy personality. However, she can show a bold side when it comes to matters involving her younger brother.

She likes the frilly maid-style apron dress uniform at her part-time job. But she feels quite reluctant about wearing it in public. Apparently, her glasses are just for show.

She likes sweets in general, especially cakes and cream-based desserts.
